entities.name: Sphinx
entities.description: Large, powerful, long-lived creatures with lion-like bodies, human faces and feathered wings, known for intellect and riddles; the iconic species of blue.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: An ancient sphinx planeswalker who authored Ravnica's legal system, created the Guildpact and founded the Azorius.

entities.name: Sharuum
entities.description: A sphinx who could tell truth from lies and showed Esper how to thin etherium.

entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: A sphinx said to have created the Etherium alloy.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Dragon who cursed the Amonkhet sphinxes into silence.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: Azorius guildmaster sphinx petrified and killed by Vraska.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Leader of the Golgari Swarm who petrified Isperia under Bolas' orders.

entities.name: Medomai
entities.description: A Theran sphinx prophet at Meletis who warns of future events.

entities.name: Raffine
entities.description: Obscura boss, the only surviving sphinx of Old Capenna's older generation.

entities.name: Founder Sphinxes
entities.description: Five elder sphinxes who founded Hexhaven in the Echoverse's Arcavios.

entities.name: Theorist
entities.description: Whose efforts shaped the Echoverse Arcavios and the Founder Sphinxes.

entities.name: Consecrated Sphinx
entities.description: A Mirrodin sphinx compleated by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Alaran shard where sphinxes were revered as leaders.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: Plane whose sphinxes were cursed by Bolas.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where sphinxes are typically Azorius.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: The institution founded by the Founder Sphinxes in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The pact created by Azor as part of Ravnica's guild system.

events.summary: Bolas curses the Amonkhet sphinxes, banning them from communicating, after his mind control fails against them.
events.quote: he placed them under a curse, banning them from communicating with other creatures in any way.

events.summary: Azor leaves Ravnica after founding the Azorius to bring order to other planes.
events.quote: he left Ravnica after some time to bring order and guidance to other planes of the Multiverse.

events.summary: Vraska petrifies and kills Isperia under Bolas' orders.
events.quote: She was petrified and killed by Vraska , leader of the Golgari Swarm , under Bolas' orders.

events.summary: In the Echoverse, harmonious mana merges to create five elder sphinxes who found Hexhaven.
events.quote: creating five elder sphinxes who later became known as the Founder Sphinxes of Hexhaven .
